label: Overstay under one month — base monetary amount
appliesTo: The first bracket of the schedule, which starts below one month and has no entry for a few days. It is an assessment framework: the authority may adjust within half the standard amount for age, circumstances, reason, consequences, ability to pay and prior violations.
why: Read in both wrong directions. It is not a fee that makes a short overstay harmless, and it is not a guaranteed invoice either — and neither reading touches the separate question of whether the person may keep living in Korea.

history.source: Immigration Act Enforcement Rule — penalty schedule
history.note: Rising to ₩3m at one month, ₩4m at three, ₩7m at six, ₩10m at one year, and ₩30m at seven years or more.
